about: Declared flows ApplyDeclaredFlows.java applies to both DSUN.EXE views after the declared entries. jumps are the table jumps FND-RNG-058's walk resolves, with the bound the walk reads before each and the distinct targets of the table's rows; decode lists the runs of walk instructions outside every range of the inventory FND-EXE-595 staged, with the walk routine that decoded each; returns lists functions the views mark as not returning that return, and fallThroughs instructions whose next instruction runs after them, each with the reason. walk_declared_flows.py writes jumps and decode; returns and fallThroughs are written by hand. Resident addresses are segment:offset with the load image at segment 0x1000, overlay addresses shipped-file offsets.

returns.reason: its one path runs to the retf at 1000:3F7D; the jae at 1000:3F6F only skips the movsb

fallThroughs.reason: the int3 at 4842:04DA returns to the jmp at 4842:04DB, which loops back to the sti at 4842:04D9
